body:
`workspace_acceptance.Root.test_opening_a_cloned_rust_project_fetches_again` fails: `check` runs cargo in the sandbox, cargo tries to refresh a git checkout under `cargo_home/git/checkouts`, and fails with `Read-only file system (os error 30)` because `migrate.cargo_sandbox_args` binds `cargo_home/git` read-only. It failed in the investigation of task:52901612e796bca4 and again in a later `run rust-acceptance`. Find whether D-264's sandbox changes caused it, and fix it so the fetch happens outside the sandbox or is allowed to write there, without widening what the sandbox can write.

Check: `run rust-acceptance` passes with this test not listed as FAIL.
title: Opening a cloned Rust project can fetch its git dependencies again in the sandbox
